text: Question forty-two, at the end of this quiz, trips up most fans. Keep your score.
Warm-up time. Which company is behind the GTA games?
Rockstar Games. Yes, it really was that easy.
Let's go way back. What year did the very first GTA hit shelves?
1997. It launched on November 28, 1997. Dial-up was still a thing.
Time for a dimension upgrade. Which game took GTA into 3D back in 2001?
GTA three. Everything got a little rounder.
Sunshine, neon and questionable decisions. Which real US city inspired Vice City?
Miami. Pastel shirts not included.
California and Nevada walk into a video game. Which 2004 GTA is set in that state?
San Andreas. Still a legend.
Fans know this one in their sleep. Who is the main character of GTA four?
Niko Bellic. Now someone call him about bowling.
Did you know? GTA four scored 98 on Metacritic.
Fastest guess! Three seconds! How many playable main characters does GTA five have?
Three. Michael, Franklin and Trevor.
Time to meet the neighbors. What's the fictional state GTA six is set in?
Leonida. Remember that name.
An old friend is back. Which city is the heart of GTA six?
Vice City. Welcome home.
Did you know? The original Vice City was set in 1986.
Big date check. When did GTA six launch?
November 19, 2026. Hopefully you were already playing.
Bonus round! Name that trailer song. Which Tom Petty track plays in the very first GTA six trailer?
Love Is a Long Road. Great song, great trailer.
Console warriors, listen up. Which platform did GTA six NOT launch on?
PC. Console only for now. Sorry, keyboard fans.
Meet the lead. Who is the female lead of GTA six?
Lucia. Easy points.
And her partner in crime. Who is the male lead of GTA six?
Jason. Say hi to the other half of the duo.
Think sunshine, swamps and flamingos. Which real US state inspired Leonida?
Florida. Of course it's Florida.
Rewind to the day the internet broke. In which year did Trailer one come out?
2023. And the internet did break.
Did you know? It got about 101 million views in just two days.
Level one done. If you got 12 or more, you're a real fan. Now it gets harder.
Fastest guess! Three seconds! Which GTA six region is inspired by the Everglades?
Grassrivers. Bring bug spray.
Level two: Medium. Same six seconds, tougher questions. Welcome to Leonida.
Let's meet a legend. Which actor voiced the hero of Vice City?
Ray Liotta, the series' first speaking protagonist. Smooth.
One company, one town, a lot of sugar. Which region is that?
Ambrosia. Sweet, but not for everyone.
Did you know? The Allied Crystal sugar refinery dominates the town.
A forgotten coast full of cheap motels. Which region is that?
Port Gellhorn, a former vacation spot. Maybe skip the continental breakfast.
Careful where you swim. Which animal lives in the wetlands of Grassrivers?
Alligators. Of course it's alligators.
Bonus round! One of these is NOT a real region of Leonida. Spot the fake.
Blueberry Bay. It's made up. Sorry, no blueberries. The six real regions are Vice City, Mount Kalaga, Grassrivers, the Leonida Keys, Ambrosia and Port Gellhorn.
Another trailer drop. In which month and year did Trailer two come out?
May 2025. Remember how hyped we were?
Did you know? It reportedly reached about 475 million views across platforms in 24 hours.
Someone's running an empire in Vice City. Who?
Boobie Ike. Business is booming.
Who is the seasoned bank robber?
Raul Bautista. Seasoned, as promised.
Quick headcount. How many main playable characters does GTA six have?
Two, Lucia and Jason. Buddy system.
Did you know? Jason Duval is a former Army soldier.
Which music duo is signed to Only Raw Records?
Real Dimez. Catchy name.
Name that tune. Which Pointer Sisters song plays in Trailer two?
Hot Together. Yes, it's stuck in your head now.
Fastest guess! Three seconds! What engine does GTA six run on?
RAGE.
Did you know? It stands for Rockstar Advanced Game Engine.
Another trailer track. Which band performs Everybody Have Fun Tonight?
Wang Chung. Everybody, indeed.
Let's do some counting. Not counting spin-offs and handheld games, which main game is GTA six?
The eighth. Time flies.
Patience check. How many times was GTA six delayed before November 19, 2026?
Twice. We all aged a little.
Did you know? The window moved from 2025 to May 26, 2026, then to November 19, 2026.
Bonus round! What score did GTA six get on Metacritic on PS five?
99, tying Ocarina of Time for the highest Metascore ever. Not bad.
Level two done. Twelve questions left, and they get brutal. Eyes on your score.
Level three: Hard. Seven seconds a question. This is where real fans separate from tourists.
Jason's past is not glamorous. Which area did he work in for drug runners?
The Leonida Keys. Rough commute.
Where does Lucia's story start? Hint: there are bars.
Leonida Penitentiary. Not a resort.
Quick one. What's Lucia's last name?
Caminos. Lucia Caminos. Say it like a spy.
Fastest guess! Three seconds! What's Jason's last name?
Duval. Jason Duval.
Who is Jason's paranoid friend?
Cal Hampton. He's not paranoid if they're really watching.
Who co-owns Only Raw Records with Boobie Ike?
Dre'Quan Priest. Business partners.
Did you know? Only Raw Records signs the duo Real Dimez.
Country classics. Which Tammy Wynette song is heard in Trailer two?
Talkin' to Myself Again. Sing along quietly.
Dig into the archives. In what year did Rockstar officially confirm GTA six?
2022, on February 4. Long wait.
Critics' corner. How many perfect scores were in the PS five launch review roundup?
118, out of 147 reviews. The critics were happy.
Did you know? The lowest score was an 80, which cited a slow stretch early on.
Who voices Jason's landlord, Brian Heder?
Stephen Root. Hard one. No shame if you missed it.
A leak! How long before its official release did Trailer one leak?
About one day. Rockstar then released it on December 5, 2023. Awkward.
Question forty-two. The one that trips up most fans. Rockstar North was formerly known as which studio?
DMA Design. The studio behind it all.
Did you know? The original GTA was created by David Jones and Mike Dailly.
That was Question forty-two. If you got it, you earned your rank. Let's see your score.
Legend. You probably have the map memorized. Drop a crown in the comments.
Expert. You know Leonida better than most. One more run and you hit Legend.
Good. Solid fan. The hard level is where you lost points, right?
Beginner. You know the basics. Watch the trailers again and come back.
Keep going. Everyone starts somewhere. Try again and beat your score.
Type your score out of 45 in the comments. I read them.
Which question got you? Tell me the number.
